nodes.label: CYP3A4 gene
nodes.detail: HGNC:2637, NCBI 1576, ENSG00000160868; chr7q22.1 minus strand, canonical footprint chr7:99,756,967-99,784,184 (27,218 bp), 13 exons.

nodes.label: CYP3A cluster (~220 kb)
nodes.detail: CYP3A5-CYP3A51P-CYP3A7-CYP3AP2-CYP3A4 all on the minus strand, then CYP3A43 on the plus strand; one regulatory domain with shared enhancers, not four independent genes.

nodes.label: CYP3A5
nodes.detail: ENSG00000106258; liver 156 TPM, so a genuine co-resident with CYP3A4, not an exotic paralog. Its site is taller and narrower and its CYP3A4*22-equivalent null allele *3 reaches 93% in Europeans.

nodes.label: CYP3A7
nodes.detail: ENSG00000160870; the fetal paralog, ~93% identical to CYP3A4, still 24.5 TPM in adult GTEx liver. Its pocket has nearly the same residues but cannot deform.

nodes.label: CYP3A43
nodes.detail: ENSG00000021461, the only plus-strand member, divergent from CYP3A4 with ~43.6 kb between their promoters; no structure exists and its physiological substrate is unknown.

nodes.label: CYP3A4*22 (rs35599367)
nodes.detail: Intron-6 variant 191 bp upstream of exon 7 that roughly doubles a partial-intron-6-retention transcript in liver but not intestine; the product lacks the heme-binding signature.

nodes.label: CYP3A4*1B (rs2740574)
nodes.detail: chr7:99,784,473, i.e. -289 from the TSS and -392 from the ATG - the source of the -290/-392 naming confusion. Functional effect contested and probably null.

nodes.label: CYP3A5*3 (rs776746)
nodes.detail: Cryptic splice site causing exon 3B inclusion and a premature stop; 93% in Non-Finnish Europeans vs 30.5% in African ancestries, one of the steepest clines in the pharmacogenome.

nodes.label: CYP3A4 p.I301T (VDDR3)
nodes.detail: De novo gain-of-function in SRS-4 with 10-fold higher calcitriol turnover and decreased activity on other substrates; causes Mendelian vitamin D-dependent rickets type 3.

nodes.label: Proximal ER6 (PXRE), -172/-149
nodes.detail: chr7:99,784,333-99,784,356. An imperfect everted repeat with a 6-bp spacer, bound by PXR:RXRa, VDR:RXR and weakly CAR; RXRA and HNF4A ENCODE peaks span it.

nodes.label: XREM, -7836/-7607
nodes.detail: chr7:99,791,791-99,792,020. DNase footprints FP3 (DR3, -7738/-7715) and FP4 (ER6, -7698/-7682) overlap PXR motifs; the densest, highest-scoring ENCODE TF cluster in the whole region.

nodes.label: CLEM4, -11.4/-10.5 kb
nodes.detail: chr7:99,794,684-99,795,584, the constitutive liver enhancer. Gel shifts name HNF-1a, HNF-4a, USF1 and AP-1, and ENCODE reproduces every one of them at near-maximal score.

nodes.label: R4 (CYP3A43-proximal contact region)
nodes.detail: A 4C-identified region ~5 kb upstream of CYP3A43 whose CRISPR deletion INCREASES CYP3A4 and decreases CYP3A43 - competitive domain interaction inside the cluster. Contains rs62471956, in complete LD with CYP3A4*22.

nodes.label: PXR (NR1I2)
nodes.detail: The dominant xenosensor; binds both the proximal ER6 and the XREM DR3/ER6, and cooperation between the two is required for maximal induction (3-fold alone, ~50-fold with hPXR).

nodes.label: CAR (NR1I3)
nodes.detail: Two high-affinity motifs at about -7,720 and -150. Its response elements ALSO mediate PXR transactivation, so element mutagenesis cannot separate CAR from PXR.

nodes.label: VDR
nodes.detail: Mediates 1,25(OH)2D3 induction through the proximal ER6, prominently in intestine; PXR is explicitly excluded in that system.

nodes.label: HNF4A
nodes.detail: The liver-specificity factor - required for PXR/CAR induction and for basal expression - but whether it acts through a fixed XREM DR1 or by PXR-dependent recruitment is contested.

nodes.label: GR (NR3C1)
nodes.detail: Acts mostly indirectly and biphasically: nanomolar dexamethasone induces PXR and CAR mRNA (3-4x), supramicromolar ligates PXR directly (15-30x). No GRE has ever been mapped at CYP3A4.

nodes.label: RXRA
nodes.detail: The obligate heterodimer partner at every CYP3A4 element, and itself induced by glucocorticoids - which is part of how GR amplifies the response.

nodes.label: USF1
nodes.detail: Binds CLEM4; the natural -11,129_-11,128insTGT variant disrupts its site and costs 36% of enhancer activity. ENCODE gives it a maximal-score peak at CLEM4.

nodes.label: HNF1A
nodes.detail: A CLEM4 constitutive factor by gel shift, confirmed by an ENCODE peak at score 590 over the module.

nodes.label: FXR (NR1H4)
nodes.detail: Splits the regulon: it REPRESSES CYP3A4 indirectly via SHP (GW4064 cuts mRNA 75%) while directly INDUCING the efflux pump ABCC2.

nodes.label: SHP (NR0B2)
nodes.detail: A receptor with no DNA-binding domain that represses PXR, CAR and GR transactivation by reducing PXR's recruitment of HNF4a and SRC-1 to CYP3A4 chromatin; PXR in turn represses the SHP promoter.

nodes.label: NF-kB p65 (RELA)
nodes.detail: Represses CYP3A4 by binding RXRa's DNA-binding domain and displacing the PXR:RXRa complex from DNA - a protein-protein mechanism, not a kB site at the CYP3A4 promoter.

nodes.label: C/EBPbeta-LIP
nodes.detail: The IL-6 effector: gp130-dependent and explicitly JAK/STAT-independent, LIP accumulates and competes out C/EBPalpha and C/EBPbeta-LAP, which are activators.

nodes.label: AhR
nodes.detail: A REPRESSOR here, not an inducer: TCDD lowers CYP3A4 and PXR mRNA, and AhR knockdown raises both basal and rifampicin-induced CYP3A4. No XRE has been mapped at the locus.

nodes.label: DBP / E4BP4 (clock output)
nodes.detail: DBP activates and E4BP4 represses CYP3A4 transcription near the TSS, generating circadian rhythm through D-box and E-box elements; no D-box coordinate has been published.

nodes.label: NCOA1 / SRC-1
nodes.detail: Recruited with HNF4a to CYP3A4 chromatin by rifampicin-activated PXR; its recruitment is what SHP blocks.

nodes.label: p300 / NCOA6
nodes.detail: ChIP-measured at both PXREs after rifampicin: NCOA6 +3.1x distal and +3.2x proximal, p300 +2.2x and +1.6x, alongside H3K4me3 up and H3K27me3 down.

nodes.label: NCOR2 / SMRT
nodes.detail: Binds PXR's LBD through its ID2; overexpression inhibits and silencing enhances PXR transactivation of the CYP3A4 promoter, and rifampicin exchanges SMRT for RAC3.

nodes.label: CYP3A4 mRNA (NM_017460.6)
nodes.detail: MANE Select, 2,781 nt: 103 nt 5'UTR, 1,512 nt CDS, 1,166 nt 3'UTR over 13 exons. Ensembl annotates 35 transcripts in total, 27 coding and 7 NMD.

nodes.label: Intron-6-retention transcript (ENST00000480043)
nodes.detail: A partial intron-6 retention carrying an in-frame stop and an internal AATAAA; the product lacks the heme-binding signature, so CYP3A4*22 gives less enzyme rather than a variant enzyme.

nodes.label: Short-3'UTR isoform (~457 nt)
nodes.detail: An alternative-polyadenylation isoform preferentially expressed in developed liver and differentiated hepatocytes, preferentially induced by rifampicin, more stable (3.7 vs 2.2 h) and giving 2.4-fold more protein.

nodes.label: Long-3'UTR isoform (1,166 nt)
nodes.detail: The RefSeq-canonical 3' end, relatively more abundant in fetal liver and less inducible; both polyA signals are annotated inside NM_017460.6 itself.

nodes.label: miR-27b-3p
nodes.detail: The only CYP3A4 miRNA validated by three labs: direct 3'UTR reporter plus seed mutant plus western, AND indirect action on the VDR 3'UTR. Explains 20.0% of CYP3A activity variance across 55 livers.

nodes.label: miR-206
nodes.detail: Direct CYP3A4 3'UTR site with an MRE mutant; 5.8% of CYP3A activity variance. Single lab.

nodes.label: miR-627
nodes.detail: Direct 3'UTR targeting confirmed by two independent groups with GFP-reporter, seed mutant and western.

nodes.label: miR-148a-3p
nodes.detail: Acts INDIRECTLY, on the PXR/NR1I2 3'UTR, not on CYP3A4. Contested: a later study found all the correlations null across 24 livers.

nodes.label: svRNAb (vault-RNA-derived)
nodes.detail: A vault-RNA-derived small RNA, not a miRNA, that targets the CYP3A4 3'UTR; replicated in HepG2 and 19 human livers. Usually forgotten.

nodes.label: CYP3A4-AS1 / AC069294.1
nodes.detail: A 350 nt antisense transcript inside the CYP3A4 gene body; knockdown raises CYP3A4 ~3x. CONTESTED: 0.53 TPM against its target's 335, zero replications, and an independent WGCNA of the same data did not find it.

nodes.label: 5'UTR uORF (uAUG at nt 27)
nodes.detail: The 103 nt 5'UTR carries exactly one uAUG opening an 11-codon uORF with a weak Kozak - but it is absent from both GENCODE Ribo-seq ORF catalogues and from sORFs.org, with working positive controls. Sequence feature, no ribosome support.

nodes.label: DRR (shared distal regulatory region)
nodes.detail: A 4C-identified region ~90 kb from the CYP3A4 promoter that loops to CYP3A4, CYP3A5 and CYP3A7; CRISPR deletion drops all three. Reproducibility flag: the paper gives no chr7 coordinates and names no genome assembly.

nodes.label: CYP3A4 protein
nodes.detail: 503 aa single-pass ER membrane protein, heme-thiolate monooxygenase; proximal ligand Cys442; 131 PDB entries, all the soluble delta-N catalytic domain alone.

nodes.label: Heme b (protoporphyrin IX-Fe)
nodes.detail: The catalytic cofactor, held by the Cys442 thiolate; resting state six-coordinate low-spin with an axial water that substrate binding displaces.

nodes.label: Cys442 (proximal thiolate)
nodes.detail: The invariant heme ligand in all four CYP3A paralogs; the one residue none of them can change.

nodes.label: F-F'-G'-G fragment (~202-260)
nodes.detail: The mobile lid; its F'-G' face inserts into the ER bilayer and it carries the peripheral site, the oligomer interface and the residues that do 83% of pose exclusion in our co-folded models.

nodes.label: Phenylalanine cluster (roof)
nodes.detail: Phe57/108/213/215/219/220/241/304 form the ordered hydrophobic roof above the heme; Phe304 is the size gatekeeper and adopts different rotamers in CYP3A4 vs CYP3A5.

nodes.label: Peripheral / effector site
nodes.detail: A surface groove ~17-21 A from the iron above the Phe cluster, resolved with progesterone (1W0F/5A1P/5A1R) and caffeine (8SO1/8SO2); contacts R212/F213/D214/D217/F219/F220/I238/C239/V240. Sits on a crystal-packing interface, which its proponents concede.

nodes.label: Substrate access channel
nodes.detail: A third resolved locus ~12-14 A from the iron; fluorol binds here in 8DYC via Thr224 and Arg372, and caffeine occupies it in 8SO1/8SO2.

nodes.label: Active site cavity
nodes.detail: Large, apolar and deformable: reported behaviour spans a ~20% contraction on midazolam to a >80% expansion on ketoconazole/erythromycin relative to ligand-free.

nodes.label: Ser119
nodes.detail: The one reproducible polar anchor at the cavity rim; H-bonds midazolam's imidazole N and is lost in cobicistat, costing affinity.

nodes.label: Proximal redox-partner face
nodes.detail: K96, K115, K121, K127, K130, K141, K421, R422, K424, K428, K440, R446 - measured at 9.7 A from the iron and 10.7 A from the nearest modelled F/G residue, across the porphyrin from every ligand.

nodes.label: POR (NADPH-cytochrome P450 reductase)
nodes.detail: 677 aa, TM 22-42, FAD+FMN; the obligatory electron donor. A 1:1 CYP3A4:POR Nanodisc complex is fully competent, but no structure of the complex exists.

nodes.label: CYB5A (cytochrome b5)
nodes.detail: 134 aa, TM 109-131; binds CYP3A4 in the 2.5-61 nM band, and its affinity drops when CYP3A4 has a ligand bound. Whether it donates the second electron or acts allosterically is a 30-year argument.

nodes.label: CYP3A4-b5-POR ternary complex
nodes.detail: Supported by POR titration restoring b5 fluorescence (Kd,app 89 nM) and by gel filtration; contradicted by rapid-kinetic work arguing for mutually exclusive binary complexes.

nodes.label: PGRMC1
nodes.detail: 195 aa heme protein (Tyr113 axial, PDB 4X8Y) that must dimerise through heme-heme stacking to bind P450s; the only protein UniProt annotates as a CYP3A4 interactor, but reported to INHIBIT CYP3A4 and to bind POR.

nodes.label: FABP1 (liver fatty-acid-binding protein)
nodes.detail: Binds diazepam and sulfinpyrazone at Kd < 2.5 uM and, by kinetic modelling, performs directed substrate transfer to CYP3A4 rather than simple sequestration.

nodes.label: CYP2E1
nodes.detail: Forms mixed oligomers with CYP3A4; alcohol-induced CYP2E1 in human liver microsomes raises CYP3A4's rate and abolishes its homotropic cooperativity.

nodes.label: CYP3A4 homo-oligomer
nodes.detail: Concentration- and membrane-density-dependent; only 50% of oligomeric CYP3A4 is reducible by a flavin domain vs near-complete for the monomer, and the interface resembles the crystallographic dimer - i.e. the same F'-G' surface as the peripheral site.

nodes.label: ER membrane (POPC/POPG bilayer)
nodes.detail: Not a passive support: native liver lipid beats synthetic PC for POR-CYP3A4 coupling, POPC nanodiscs give much higher fragment binding than DMPC or DPhPC, and the F'-G' face is bilayer-embedded.

nodes.label: gp78 / AMFR (E3 ligase)
nodes.detail: ER-membrane E3 that ubiquitinates CYP3A4 with UBC7/UBE2G2; oscillates antiphase to CYP3A4 and drives its circadian proteolysis.

nodes.label: CHIP / STUB1 (E3 ligase)
nodes.detail: The second CYP3A4 E3, working with UbcH5a; double knockdown with gp78 stabilises CYP3A4 in a still-catalytic form.

nodes.label: Second ligand copy (co-substrate)
nodes.detail: Measured in 6 of 122 CYP3A4 PDB entries and clash-free in every case; kinetically, one testosterone is uncoupled, two give the maximal rate, three improve coupling.

nodes.label: Reactome: Xenobiotics
nodes.detail: The ONLY one of Reactome's six CYP-by-substrate-type children that contains CYP3A4; sterols, fatty acids, eicosanoids and vitamins all exclude it.

nodes.label: Reactome: Aflatoxin activation and detoxification
nodes.detail: A direct child of Biological oxidations holding the three CYP3A4 aflatoxin reactions and the GST conjugation that follows them.

nodes.label: Reactome: Drug ADME
nodes.detail: A top-level pathway with eight drug-specific children; CYP3A4 appears in the aspirin, atorvastatin and prednisone ones.

nodes.label: Reactome: Biosynthesis of maresin-like SPMs
nodes.detail: The one lipid pathway Reactome does place CYP3A4 in, via DHA 14(R)-hydroxylation - a specialised pro-resolving mediator route.

nodes.label: KEGG: Steroid hormone biosynthesis
nodes.detail: KEGG places CYP3A4 here, where Reactome does not - the two databases genuinely disagree about whether CYP3A4 is a steroid enzyme.

nodes.label: KEGG: Bile secretion
nodes.detail: Carries EC 1.14.14.57 taurochenodeoxycholate 6alpha-hydroxylase, the bile-acid reaction that is absent from UniProt's catalytic block.

nodes.label: KEGG: Retinol metabolism
nodes.detail: CYP3A4 oxidises retinol to retinal and retinoate to 4-hydroxyretinoate, putting it in the retinoic-acid termination pathway beside the dedicated CYP26 family.

nodes.label: KEGG: Chemical carcinogenesis - DNA adducts
nodes.detail: KEGG network nt06250, element N01378 'AFB1 to DNA adducts' - the bioactivation role, which sits awkwardly with calling CYP3A4 a detoxification enzyme.

nodes.label: KEGG: Drug metabolism - cytochrome P450
nodes.detail: The canonical drug-metabolism membership; CYP3A4 is the major pathway for ~40% of the top-200 prescribed drugs and 64% of 2005-2016 approvals.

nodes.label: KEGG: Linoleic acid metabolism
nodes.detail: Linoleate 11-hydroxylation (RHEA:52284). Note KEGG does NOT list CYP3A4 in hsa00590 arachidonic acid metabolism despite four arachidonate Rhea reactions in UniProt.

nodes.label: Phase II conjugation (UGT/SULT/GST)
nodes.detail: UGT1A4/2B4/2B7 glucuronidate hydroxymidazolam, SULT2A1 sulfates lithocholic acid, and GSTM1/P1/T1 trap the aflatoxin epoxide - all induced by the same PXR that induces CYP3A4.

nodes.label: ABCB1 / P-gp
nodes.detail: Co-induced with CYP3A4 through a PXR DR4 at about -8 kb and co-expressed in villus-tip enterocytes, but the 'shared substrate space' claim has never been quantified against a chance baseline.

nodes.label: ABCC2 / MRP2
nodes.detail: Induced by FXR, PXR and CAR through an unusual ER-8 element 440 bp upstream - a third element geometry for the same receptor.

nodes.label: SLCO1B1 / OATP1B1
nodes.detail: The hepatic uptake step upstream of CYP3A4 for many drugs, but canonically HNF1A-driven; no evidence it is a PXR target co-regulated with CYP3A4.

nodes.label: Pericentral (zone 3) hepatocyte
nodes.detail: The main site of CYP3A4. Visium HD gives a zone3:zone1 ratio of 21.1x - steeper than CYP2E1 (11.7x) and GLUL (4.7x) - and CYP3A4 is the first-listed pericentral landmark gene.

nodes.label: Periportal (zone 1) hepatocyte
nodes.detail: Low CYP3A4 but the zone where CYP3A5 is relatively higher (1.8x periportal), so any non-isoform-specific 'CYP3A' measurement averages two oppositely zonated enzymes.

nodes.label: Fetal hepatoblast
nodes.detail: CYP3A7-positive in 69.88% of 11,673 cells against CYP3A4 in 0.09% (10 cells); two further fetal atlases return zero CYP3A4-positive cells.

nodes.label: Mature small-intestinal enterocyte
nodes.detail: The only large extrahepatic site (HPA 2039.8 nCPM). Expression jumps ~40-60x at terminal differentiation: crypt stem 1.26% -> transit-amplifying 0.80% -> mature enterocyte 51.28%.

nodes.label: Colonocyte
nodes.detail: Effectively off: 0.79% of cells, and 551-fold below enterocytes by HPA nCPM. The duodenum:colon ratio is about 250x.

nodes.label: Non-parenchymal liver cells
nodes.detail: Cholangiocytes, stellate cells, Kupffer cells, LSECs and lymphocytes carry no pharmacologically meaningful CYP3A4; apparent signal is hepatocyte ambient RNA (Kupffer 33% by snRNA-seq vs 2.5% by CITE-seq).

nodes.label: Liver (whole tissue)
nodes.detail: GTEx median 335.3 TPM across 226 donors, but p95/p5 = 218x; HPA consensus 3367 nTPM, Tau 0.93, tissue-enriched.

nodes.label: Small intestine (duodenum/jejunum)
nodes.detail: GTEx ileum 48.3 TPM; microsomal CYP3A falls duodenum 31 -> ileum 17 pmol/mg with midazolam Vmax 644 -> 68, at constant Km ~4 uM, so the gradient is abundance not affinity.

nodes.label: State: rifampicin induction
nodes.detail: PHH mRNA 23x, protein 12x, activity 13x at 10 uM; clinically oral midazolam AUC -91% vs IV -52% in the same subjects, with bioavailability down 88%.

nodes.label: State: IL-6 / inflammation
nodes.detail: PHH CYP3A4 mRNA falls below 5% of control at 10 ng/mL IL-6; in patients the CYP3A metabolic ratio drops 61% by day 3 after elective surgery. IL-6 also lowers PXR and CAR mRNA.

nodes.label: State: pregnancy
nodes.detail: Third-trimester midazolam CL/F(unbound) rises 72% in a paired study; the canonical figure is ~+100%, but dextromethorphan gives only +35-38% and flat across trimesters - the probes disagree ~2x.

nodes.label: State: fasting
nodes.detail: 36 h fasting INCREASES midazolam clearance 12% (p<0.01) and a 3-day high-fat diet does nothing - the opposite sign to the FGF21-represses-PXR mechanism, and nobody has reconciled them.

nodes.label: State: MASLD / MASH
nodes.detail: CONTESTED: one study reports 2.4-fold higher plasma midazolam and 69% lower hepatic mRNA in NASH; another, on 52 graded banked livers, finds mRNA unchanged and protein/activity non-significant.

nodes.label: Hepatocyte identity co-expression module
nodes.detail: ARCHS4 Pearson top neighbours are OTC 0.728, ALDOB 0.716, ABCG8 0.694, APOC3 0.685, SLC2A2 0.678, CYP2C9 0.652 - the urea-cycle/gluconeogenic/apolipoprotein/sterol-transport programme, not other CYPs.

nodes.label: testosterone
nodes.detail: The canonical CYP3A4 marker substrate (6beta-OH) and the only ligand whose 1-/2-/3-molecule occupancy states have been kinetically resolved; 1 bound = uncoupled, 2 = max rate.

nodes.label: midazolam
nodes.detail: The clinical CYP3A4 probe, a crystal structure (5TE8) that CONTRACTS the cavity ~20%, and a documented second (allosteric) site in the F'/G' region.

nodes.label: erythromycin
nodes.detail: Macrolide that expands the active site >80% and shows multiple binding modes: the upper end of the size envelope.

nodes.label: ketoconazole
nodes.detail: Type II azole crystallised as TWO copies in one active site: the cleanest structural case of double occupancy in CYP3A4.

nodes.label: ritonavir
nodes.detail: Thiazole-N heme ligation plus Ser119 H-bond plus F-F' contacts: the worked example that coordination alone does not determine affinity.

nodes.label: cobicistat
nodes.detail: Ritonavir analogue whose morpholine clashes with and disorders the F-F' connector while keeping identical heme ligation: a direct F/G-loop probe.

nodes.label: progesterone
nodes.detail: The ligand that defined the peripheral/effector site in 1W0F (also 5A1P/5A1R) and is oxidised at both 6beta and 16alpha: the homotropic-cooperativity archetype.

nodes.label: caffeine
nodes.detail: Three and six copies resolved simultaneously in the active site, the channel and the peripheral surface (8SO1/8SO2): the strongest multi-occupancy evidence in the family.

nodes.label: bergamottin
nodes.detail: Grapefruit furanocoumarin, mechanism-based inactivator co-crystallised as a suicide substrate: the covalent/cryptic-electrophile class.

nodes.label: bromoergocryptine
nodes.detail: The largest CYP3A4 co-crystal ligand (~650 Da ergoline): tests whether a scorer can thread the channel, not just fill the cavity.

nodes.label: cholesterol
nodes.detail: Oxidised by CYP3A4 at C4beta, C22R, C24R, C25 and C26 - the endogenous substrate that fixes the pocket's real design brief.

nodes.label: 4beta-hydroxycholesterol
nodes.detail: The CYP3A4-specific product used clinically as the endogenous activity biomarker and itself an LXR agonist: product-side ground truth.

nodes.label: lithocholic acid
nodes.detail: 6alpha-hydroxylated by CYP3A4 and a PXR agonist that induces it: a closed endogenous feed-forward loop, and an anionic-rim test case.

nodes.label: dehydroepiandrosterone 3-sulfate
nodes.detail: Four copies resolved in CYP3A7 (8GK3) occupying active site, stacked site, channel and the membrane-facing F'-G' face: the whole binding ladder in one entry.

nodes.label: calcitriol (1alpha,25-(OH)2-D3)
nodes.detail: Inactivated by CYP3A4; the I301T gain-of-function variant causes Mendelian rickets (VDDR3), so this substrate carries hard physiological constraint on pocket geometry.

nodes.label: all-trans retinoic acid
nodes.detail: 4-hydroxylated by CYP3A4 and 4-/18-hydroxylated by CYP3A7: a long polyene with a carboxylate head, i.e. apolar core + polar rim in its purest form.

nodes.label: anandamide
nodes.detail: Epoxidised at 8,9-, 11,12- and 14,15- by CYP3A4: the coiled-chain geometry that the same site must serve alongside rigid steroids.

nodes.label: arachidonic acid
nodes.detail: Hydroxylated at 7/10/13 and epoxidised to both 14,15-EET enantiomers: tests whether a scorer can place a flexible C20 chain at all.

nodes.label: aflatoxin B1
nodes.detail: Bioactivated to the 8,9-exo-epoxide; the positively selected residues 478/479 change WHICH metabolite forms, so pose orientation is the whole readout.

nodes.label: nifedipine
nodes.detail: Classic heterotropic-activation acceptor (activated by testosterone and alpha-naphthoflavone): the standard two-ligand probe.

nodes.label: alpha-naphthoflavone
nodes.detail: The canonical heterotropic EFFECTOR; in nanodiscs it shows negligible BINDING cooperativity, so it separates occupancy effects from true allostery.

nodes.label: cyclosporin A
nodes.detail: 1202 Da macrocycle, cleared almost entirely by CYP3A4: the beyond-Rule-of-5 extreme and the class the evolution doc predicts is under-assayed.

nodes.label: tacrolimus
nodes.detail: 804 Da macrolide with a narrow therapeutic index whose clearance is the main clinical consequence of the CYP3A5*3 polymorphism.

nodes.label: atorvastatin
nodes.detail: High-volume clinical substrate with an acidic tail that must sit at the rim: tests the 'charge is handled at the rim' constraint.

nodes.label: Delta-9-tetrahydrocannabinol
nodes.detail: A 2025 co-crystal of a neutral, very lipophilic, membrane-partitioning ligand: the lateral-entry class with recent ground truth.

nodes.label: azamulin
nodes.detail: The standard selective CYP3A inhibitor, co-crystallised in both CYP3A4 (6OOA) and CYP3A5 (7SV2): a ready-made paralog discrimination pair.

nodes.label: clotrimazole
nodes.detail: Same ligand crystallised in CYP3A4 and CYP3A5: a leak-free test of whether a scorer is sensitive to lid geometry rather than sequence identity.

nodes.label: metformin
nodes.detail: A small, rigid, highly polar molecule that BINDS CYP3A4 but is essentially a non-substrate: the negative control for 'fills the cavity'.

nodes.label: 1,8-cineole
nodes.detail: A 154 Da plant monoterpene ether on the curated UniProt reaction list: the small-molecule floor of the substrate envelope.

meta.title: CYP3A4 biology map: gene to pathway to cell type
meta.status_note: Every node and every edge carries `status`, the machine-readable form of the companion document's evidence marks. ESTABLISHED = multiple independent sources or one primary measurement with a named method; CONTESTED = the literature genuinely disagrees and the document gives both sides; INFERRED = reasoning, not a reported result; NO_EVIDENCE_FOUND = looked for and not found, which is not the same as refuted.

ranked_partners.name: A second copy of the query ligand
ranked_partners.why: The only 'partner' with CYP3A4 structural precedent - measured multi-occupancy in 6 of 122 entries, clash-free in every case (min inter-copy distance 2.90 A) - and the only one that touches the F/G roof. Kinetically, one testosterone is uncoupled, two give the maximal rate.
ranked_partners.rationale: RUN AND REFUTED, 2026-09. 49 OpenProtein jobs. The second copy landed in the ACTIVE SITE on 12 of 15 ligands rather than in the peripheral groove, and the first copy got WORSE by -0.0664 LDDT-PLI with rotation error moving +4.45 degrees in the wrong direction. The geometric reasoning held up: the model placed the second copy at a median 8.81 A from the iron, reproducing 2V0M's second ketoconazole unprompted, and 45 of 60 second copies did contact the groove residue set - but from inside the cavity. The prediction about WHERE it would go was right; the prediction that it would help was wrong.

ranked_partners.name: Membrane lipid (POPC, or 1:1 POPC:POPG)
ranked_partners.why: The F'-G' face is bilayer-embedded and 8GK3 resolves a steroid sulfate sitting on it; lipid identity measurably changes ligand binding (POPC gives much higher fragment binding than DMPC or DPhPC) and native liver lipid beats synthetic PC for POR-CYP3A4 coupling. Also just extra ligand entities - no second chain.
ranked_partners.rationale: Now the ONLY untested partner on this list, but its prior is LOWERED by the second-ligand result: the one thing that has actually been measured is that adding mass on the distal side makes the pose worse. The hypothesis that survives is narrower than it was - that lipid restrains residues 211-216 from OUTSIDE the cavity, where a second ligand demonstrably acts from inside. Run it as a falsification test, not as an expected gain.

ranked_partners.name: CYB5A (cytochrome b5)
ranked_partners.why: The tightest-binding protein partner, Kd in the 2.5-61 nM band, and the only one whose affinity for CYP3A4 measurably changes when a ligand is bound. Required for maximal bile-acid 6alpha-hydroxylation.
ranked_partners.rationale: FINDING 024 measured the proximal interface at 9.7 A from the iron and 10.7 A from the nearest modelled F/G residue, ACROSS the porphyrin, with protein accuracy uncorrelated with ligand error (rho=+0.03). No CYP3A4-b5 complex exists to validate against.

ranked_partners.name: POR / the POR FMN domain
ranked_partners.why: The obligatory electron donor, competent as a 1:1 complex, and possibly an allosteric modulator - MS footprinting on CYP2A6 found increased surface exposure, and POR mutations change CYP1A2 regioselectivity.
ranked_partners.rationale: Same geometry argument as b5. Nine POR structures exist and none is in complex with any P450, so the interface would itself be an unvalidated prediction.

ranked_partners.name: CYP3A4 itself (homodimer)
ranked_partners.why: The oligomer interface, by crosslinking and LRET, resembles the crystallographic dimer - i.e. it IS the F'-G' surface that carries the peripheral site. Oligomerisation halves the fraction of enzyme a flavin domain can reduce and is required for alpha-naphthoflavone activation.
ranked_partners.rationale: The interface is unvalidated and an extra chain adds degrees of freedom, not opinions (FINDING 009). Distinct from the refuted second-ligand test in that it acts from outside the cavity, but there is no structure to fold against.

ranked_partners.name: CYP2E1
ranked_partners.why: Forms mixed oligomers with CYP3A4; alcohol-induced CYP2E1 in human liver microsomes raises CYP3A4's rate and abolishes its homotropic cooperativity - a physiological perturbation changing a CYP3A4 kinetic signature.
ranked_partners.rationale: Lower priority than the homodimer because the interface is the same one.

ranked_partners.name: PGRMC1
ranked_partners.why: The only protein UniProt annotates as a CYP3A4 interactor, with a 1.95 A structure of its own heme-stacked dimer (4X8Y) and a requirement for that dimerisation.
ranked_partners.rationale: The sign is disputed - the one quantitative study reports INHIBITION partially rescued by extra POR, i.e. it may act on POR rather than on CYP3A4 - and no complex structure exists.

ranked_partners.name: FABP1
ranked_partners.why: The 2026 result that a soluble protein performs directed substrate transfer to CYP3A4, with Kd < 2.5 uM for diazepam and sulfinpyrazone. Independently, FABP1 is the 13th ARCHS4 co-expression neighbour at r = 0.634.
ranked_partners.rationale: No use for pose prediction - it is cytosolic and does not shape the pocket - but it is the reason a free-substrate assumption may be wrong in kinetic modelling.

ranked_compounds.name: testosterone
ranked_compounds.reason: The canonical CYP3A4 marker substrate (6beta-OH) and the only ligand whose 1-/2-/3-molecule occupancy states have been kinetically resolved; 1 bound = uncoupled, 2 = max rate.

ranked_compounds.name: midazolam
ranked_compounds.reason: The clinical CYP3A4 probe, a crystal structure (5TE8) that CONTRACTS the cavity ~20%, and a documented second (allosteric) site in the F'/G' region.

ranked_compounds.name: erythromycin
ranked_compounds.reason: Macrolide that expands the active site >80% and shows multiple binding modes: the upper end of the size envelope.

ranked_compounds.name: ketoconazole
ranked_compounds.reason: Type II azole crystallised as TWO copies in one active site: the cleanest structural case of double occupancy in CYP3A4.

ranked_compounds.name: ritonavir
ranked_compounds.reason: Thiazole-N heme ligation plus Ser119 H-bond plus F-F' contacts: the worked example that coordination alone does not determine affinity.

ranked_compounds.name: cobicistat
ranked_compounds.reason: Ritonavir analogue whose morpholine clashes with and disorders the F-F' connector while keeping identical heme ligation: a direct F/G-loop probe.

ranked_compounds.name: progesterone
ranked_compounds.reason: The ligand that defined the peripheral/effector site in 1W0F (also 5A1P/5A1R) and is oxidised at both 6beta and 16alpha: the homotropic-cooperativity archetype.

ranked_compounds.name: caffeine
ranked_compounds.reason: Three and six copies resolved simultaneously in the active site, the channel and the peripheral surface (8SO1/8SO2): the strongest multi-occupancy evidence in the family.

ranked_compounds.name: bergamottin
ranked_compounds.reason: Grapefruit furanocoumarin, mechanism-based inactivator co-crystallised as a suicide substrate: the covalent/cryptic-electrophile class.

ranked_compounds.name: bromoergocryptine
ranked_compounds.reason: The largest CYP3A4 co-crystal ligand (~650 Da ergoline): tests whether a scorer can thread the channel, not just fill the cavity.

ranked_compounds.name: cholesterol
ranked_compounds.reason: Oxidised by CYP3A4 at C4beta, C22R, C24R, C25 and C26 - the endogenous substrate that fixes the pocket's real design brief.

ranked_compounds.name: 4beta-hydroxycholesterol
ranked_compounds.reason: The CYP3A4-specific product used clinically as the endogenous activity biomarker and itself an LXR agonist: product-side ground truth.

ranked_compounds.name: lithocholic acid
ranked_compounds.reason: 6alpha-hydroxylated by CYP3A4 and a PXR agonist that induces it: a closed endogenous feed-forward loop, and an anionic-rim test case.

ranked_compounds.name: dehydroepiandrosterone 3-sulfate
ranked_compounds.reason: Four copies resolved in CYP3A7 (8GK3) occupying active site, stacked site, channel and the membrane-facing F'-G' face: the whole binding ladder in one entry.

ranked_compounds.name: calcitriol (1alpha,25-(OH)2-D3)
ranked_compounds.reason: Inactivated by CYP3A4; the I301T gain-of-function variant causes Mendelian rickets (VDDR3), so this substrate carries hard physiological constraint on pocket geometry.

ranked_compounds.name: all-trans retinoic acid
ranked_compounds.reason: 4-hydroxylated by CYP3A4 and 4-/18-hydroxylated by CYP3A7: a long polyene with a carboxylate head, i.e. apolar core + polar rim in its purest form.

ranked_compounds.name: anandamide
ranked_compounds.reason: Epoxidised at 8,9-, 11,12- and 14,15- by CYP3A4: the coiled-chain geometry that the same site must serve alongside rigid steroids.

ranked_compounds.name: arachidonic acid
ranked_compounds.reason: Hydroxylated at 7/10/13 and epoxidised to both 14,15-EET enantiomers: tests whether a scorer can place a flexible C20 chain at all.

ranked_compounds.name: aflatoxin B1
ranked_compounds.reason: Bioactivated to the 8,9-exo-epoxide; the positively selected residues 478/479 change WHICH metabolite forms, so pose orientation is the whole readout.

ranked_compounds.name: nifedipine
ranked_compounds.reason: Classic heterotropic-activation acceptor (activated by testosterone and alpha-naphthoflavone): the standard two-ligand probe.

ranked_compounds.name: alpha-naphthoflavone
ranked_compounds.reason: The canonical heterotropic EFFECTOR; in nanodiscs it shows negligible BINDING cooperativity, so it separates occupancy effects from true allostery.

ranked_compounds.name: cyclosporin A
ranked_compounds.reason: 1202 Da macrocycle, cleared almost entirely by CYP3A4: the beyond-Rule-of-5 extreme and the class the evolution doc predicts is under-assayed.

ranked_compounds.name: tacrolimus
ranked_compounds.reason: 804 Da macrolide with a narrow therapeutic index whose clearance is the main clinical consequence of the CYP3A5*3 polymorphism.

ranked_compounds.name: atorvastatin
ranked_compounds.reason: High-volume clinical substrate with an acidic tail that must sit at the rim: tests the 'charge is handled at the rim' constraint.

ranked_compounds.name: Delta-9-tetrahydrocannabinol
ranked_compounds.reason: A 2025 co-crystal of a neutral, very lipophilic, membrane-partitioning ligand: the lateral-entry class with recent ground truth.

ranked_compounds.name: azamulin
ranked_compounds.reason: The standard selective CYP3A inhibitor, co-crystallised in both CYP3A4 (6OOA) and CYP3A5 (7SV2): a ready-made paralog discrimination pair.

ranked_compounds.name: clotrimazole
ranked_compounds.reason: Same ligand crystallised in CYP3A4 and CYP3A5: a leak-free test of whether a scorer is sensitive to lid geometry rather than sequence identity.

ranked_compounds.name: metformin
ranked_compounds.reason: A small, rigid, highly polar molecule that BINDS CYP3A4 but is essentially a non-substrate: the negative control for 'fills the cavity'.

ranked_compounds.name: 1,8-cineole
ranked_compounds.reason: A 154 Da plant monoterpene ether on the curated UniProt reaction list: the small-molecule floor of the substrate envelope.
